key: D major (relative B minor colour in build)
note: Shared contract between score (compose.py) and picture (brand45.html). Beat k at k*0.625s; bar n (1-based) starts at (n-1)*2.5s.

sections.name: intro
sections.music: solo felt piano motif, soft air pad, room reverb; very sparse

sections.name: verse
sections.music: low strings enter, warm sub pulse on beats 1&3, piano continues

sections.name: build
sections.music: ostinato 8ths, toms/taiko from bar 10, rising riser bars 11-12, harmony climbs

sections.name: hitPreDrop
sections.music: single impact on beat 3 of bar 12, then silence/reverse swell 28.9-30

sections.name: DROP
sections.music: full climax: big impact + cymbal swell resolve, full strings & brass-like pad, taiko on every beat

sections.name: climax
sections.music: theme restated full, strongest energy; accent on every downbeat

sections.name: resolve
sections.music: drop to solo piano + pad, final chord at 40.0 rings out, fade by 45
